issues.issue: Amount and pages confirmed. Recorded as business_type.debt_proceeds (from the p2 special item), but the business-type receipt lines are taken from the p6 proprietary statement, which prints it among nonoperating revenues, and the p8 detail records it as a revenue line 'Debt Proceeds'. Under the 2026-11-06 ruling (printed among revenues -> receipt line 'Debt Proceeds'; printed under other financing -> debt_proceeds) it could instead be a business-type receipt line 'Debt issuance' (category Debt Proceeds, p6) with business_type.debt_proceeds null and reported_totals business receipts 542,114 includes []. The roll-forward holds either way (822,364 + 542,114 - 566,316 = 798,162). Judgment call because the government-wide statement shows it as a special item rather than revenue.
